system.details:
A writhing bundle of living fabric that wears you as much as you wear it. It gains two of the following benefits:

  • Words in Thread - The Ravelliko can rapidly stitch writing across itself to communicate in any language you speak,
  • Crawlscarf - The Ravelliko holds you just above the ground, moving you around with a silent, silken step,
  • Unpick - Use a task to gain a resource, Fine Thread or Coarse Fabric,
  • Spirit of Silk - Deals CQ or LR Salt damage,
  • Sewed Edging - Deals CQ or LR Keen damage,
  • Living Dye - The Ravelliko's colours swirl in vibrant, mesmeric, or camouflaging patterns,
  • Catchsail - Your Ravelliko can catch the winds - mark to gain the Rush and Glide styles until end of scene.
